The Hunt for Anakin Skywalker'' |author=[[Dave Wolverton]] |cover artist= |illustrator= |editor= |publisher=[[Scholastic]] |early release= |release date=[[May]] [[2003]]''[[Star Wars Adventures 8: The Hunt for Anakin Skywalker]]'' was released in a bundle with [[Star Wars Adventures Magazine 8|''Star Wars Adventure Magazine'' 8]], which was released in [[May]] [[2003]] |intl release= |rereleased= |media type=Paperback |pages= |isbn=0439458870 |isbn2= |isbn3= |audiobook=N/A |timeline= |series=[[Star Wars Adventures (Scholastic)|''Star Wars Adventures'' (Scholastic)]] |preceded by=''[[Star Wars Adventures 7: The Ghostling Children|The Ghostling Children]]'' |followed by=''[[Star Wars Adventures 9: Capture Arawynne|Capture Arawynne]]'' }} '''''Star Wars Adventures 8: The Hunt for Anakin Skywalker''''' was the eighth installment of [[Scholastic]]'s [[Star Wars Adventures (Scholastic)|''Star Wars Adventures'']] series.This book is a reprint of ''[[Episode I Adventures 6: The Hunt for Anakin Skywalker]]''. It consisted of a young reader novel and an accompanying game book for use with the story, and was sent out with [[Star Wars Adventures Magazine 8|''Star Wars Adventures Magazine'' 8]] in [[May]] [[2003]].
